title: upload medical document encrypt and upload to ipfs
description: Test the POST /api/upload endpoint to ensure that medical documents are encrypted using AES-256-CBC before being uploaded to IPFS. Verify that the response includes the document hash, IPFS CID, and optional risk analysis metadata. Validate input parameters and handle errors for missing or invalid files.

title: decrypt and return document from ipfs using provided key
description: Test the POST /api/decrypt-view endpoint to verify that documents can be decrypted correctly using the provided 64 hex character key. Confirm that decryption fails with an error when a wrong key is provided, and no partial or corrupted data is returned.

title: verify document hash with uploaded file
description: Test the POST /api/verify endpoint to ensure that the uploaded document's hash matches the expected hash parameter. Validate input parameters and handle errors for mismatched or malformed hashes.

title: download encrypted file from ipfs using cid
description: Test the GET /api/download/:cid endpoint to verify that encrypted files can be downloaded correctly from IPFS using the provided CID path parameter. Validate CID format and handle errors for invalid or missing CIDs.

title: mint medical record token on aptos blockchain
description: Test the mintToken blockchain function to ensure tokens are minted correctly with all required fields including document hash, IPFS CID, patient address, and record type. Verify payload structure matches Aptos Wallet Adapter v2 format.

title: get token details from blockchain with correct parsing
description: Test the getTokenDetails blockchain function to verify that it returns all 7 expected values including recordType, documentHash, ipfsCID, patientAddress, isConsumed, issuer, and timestamp. Confirm correct parsing of patient_address field.

title: consume token to prevent double claiming
description: Test the consumeToken blockchain function to ensure that tokens can be marked as consumed after verification, preventing reuse. Verify that the UI reflects the consumed status accurately.

title: verify token validity and consumption status
description: Test the verifyToken blockchain function to confirm that tokens are valid and not consumed before allowing verification. Handle invalid or consumed tokens gracefully.

title: patient dashboard filters records by connected wallet address
description: Test the patient dashboard frontend to ensure that only medical records matching the connected wallet address are displayed. Verify that no cross-patient data leakage occurs.

title: shareable verification links embed key in url hash fragment
description: Test the generation of shareable verification links in the patient dashboard to confirm that decryption keys are embedded only in the URL hash fragment (#key=...) and never in query parameters, preventing key leakage.
